title: Google Docs
description: Create, read and edit Google Docs documents

operations.title: Create a document
operations.description: Creates an empty Google Doc through the Drive API (needs the drive scope group too).

fields.label: Drive
fields.help: myDrive, or a shared drive ID (the folder decides where the file goes).

fields.label: Folder ID
fields.help: Parent folder ID; empty or default for the drive root.

operations.title: Get a document
operations.description: Returns the full document structure (body.content holds the paragraphs).

fields.label: Simplify
fields.help: Accepted for n8n compatibility; the full document is returned.

operations.title: Update a document
operations.sends_reason: Update a document: changes Google Docs data, not a message
operations.description: Applies the listed actions in one batchUpdate call.

fields.label: Simplify
fields.help: Accepted for n8n compatibility; the batchUpdate response is returned.

fields.label: Actions

Location keys: insertSegment (body|header|footer), segmentId, locationChoice (endOfSegmentLocation|location), index.
